author: Captain Bartholomew
title: Looking for 5 artists for short story illustrations
content:
Yarr mateys! I am looking for 5 artists for a small project I’m starting! Each artist will be responsible for an 8.5 x 11 inch x 300 dpi image (or two) that will be part of a short story. For all those interested, please DM me your portfolio of your best works. #envtuber #Vtuber

No AI generated images should be in the portfolio, nor will they be used for the project. All submissions must be in by no later than Nov 29th, 11:59 pm Pacific Time. You can DM me either here or on Discord. How quickly I get back will depend on how many submissions I receive.
